subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Researchers have developed a self-healing concrete that can repair cracks within 28 days of formation.
• The concrete contains dormant bacteria (microorganisms that remain inactive until specific conditions are met).
• When water enters cracks in the concrete, the bacteria become active and consume nutrients.
• When the bacteria consume nutrients, they produce limestone that fills and seals the cracks.
• The limestone formation continues until the cracks are completely sealed and the concrete is restored.
prompt: The student wants to specify how the bacteria enable crack repair. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Researchers have developed self-healing concrete that contains dormant bacteria, which remain inactive until specific conditions are met.
choices.B: The limestone formation in self-healing concrete, which contains dormant bacteria, continues until the cracks are completely sealed.
choices.C: Dormant bacteria allow self-healing concrete to repair cracks within 28 days of formation.
choices.D: When dormant bacteria in self-healing concrete consume nutrients after water activation, they produce limestone that fills and seals the cracks.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence specifies how the bacteria in self-healing concrete enable crack repair, explaining that they produce limestone that fills and seals cracks when they consume nutrients after water activation.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. The sentence explains some properties of dormant bacteria; it doesn't specify how those bacteria enable crack repair.
